nodes.name: stats.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained Rollup Visualizer HTML report (generated build artifact) showing the Voxel Blade production bundle's size distribution as an interactive treemap, with embedded compiled rendering code and inline module-tree data.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file artifact bundling a minified preact-compatible VDOM renderer with d3 hierarchy/treemap layout, plus an inline JSON tree of the rolldown output modules; SVG is produced at runtime rather than in markup.
